definition: Nurturing, healing, teaching, and care versus contest, ambition, and competitive pressure.
Other-benefiting care/service versus self-interested extraction or gain.
Cooperative mediation and collaboration versus conflict, opposition, and antagonism.
Clarity, honesty, evidence, and directness versus deception, concealment, and disguise.
Formal standards, rules, offices, and institutions versus anti-institutional or outlaw stance.
Group/system/common-good orientation versus solitary or individual self-direction.
